card.name: Denominators in dosing formulas
card.fires_on: Digits or symbols in the denominator of a written-out dosing or clearance formula, just after a fraction line of dashes. Typical examples are the 72 in creatinine clearance and numbers in infusion-rate equations.

modes.label: Creatinine clearance 72
modes.description: The number 72 or the sign after it in the denominator of the Cockcroft-Gault formula.

modes.label: Other formula denominators
modes.description: Numbers or units in the denominator of exposure, infusion or maintenance dose equations.

modes.label: Digits in worked volume figures
modes.description: Digits inside a number in a worked blood volume calculation.
